Kit 2 di EVIL Scuola, primaria: segreti: EVIL for Schools kit 2, primary: secrets that feel heavy, gifts from strangers and messages that hurt. A ready-made 50-minute lesson on asking for help.
Segreti che pesano, regali da sconosciut: Secrets that feel heavy, gifts from strangers, messages that hurt: you tell a grown-up. It isn’t telling tales, it’s asking for help.
<strong>Da rivedere.</strong> Questo kit: Under review. This kit deals with a sensitive topic and is awaiting review by child safeguarding and helpline experts. Use it after talking to your school’s contact person.

Se qualcosa online mi fa stare male, o q: If something online makes me feel bad, or someone asks me to keep a secret, I tell an adult I trust. It isn’t my fault and nobody will be cross with me: I did the right thing.

Gioco a gruppi: va tutto bene o lo dico?: Group game: all fine, or do I tell?
Gruppi da 3–4: dividono le carte nelle d: Groups of 3–4 sort the cards into the two columns. Then each group reads one card and you give the answer with its reason. Stress that telling doesn’t get anyone into trouble: it’s how you get help.
<strong>Puoi dire:</strong> «Se un messa: You can say: “If a message makes you feel bad, it isn’t a joke. And if you’re not sure, you can always ask a grown-up: that’s what grown-ups are for.”
Distribuisci i fogli bianchi e i bigliet: Hand out the blank sheets and the tickets. On the sheet everyone traces their hand and writes on each finger an adult they trust: at home, at school, elsewhere. In the palm they write the words for asking help. Remind them that school adults count too and that in Italy there is a free number for young people, 1.96.96.
